range_km.evidence: InsideEVs confirms Evolve+ FWD 19-in: 289 mi (465 km) EPA combined. Recharged.com independently confirms 289 mi EPA.

battery_kwh_usable.evidence: Same 87 kWh usable pack as FWD variant. EV-Database (96s4p NMC, 384 cells, 91 kWh nominal / 87 kWh usable), evkx.net, greencarscompare all confirm.

range_km.evidence: InsideEVs: Evolve+ e-4ORCE 19-in 272 mi EPA = 437.7 km. driving.ca lists 438 km Canadian rating for Evolve+ e-4ORCE. Within 0.2% — strong agreement.

battery_kwh_usable.evidence: Genesis Canada lists 77.4 kWh nominal pack capacity. E-GMP platform standard buffer ~4.4% gives ~74.0 kWh usable. Sources cite 77.4 as gross — keeping 74.0 usable as Medium since usable not directly published by Genesis.
